connection.instructions: Click **Connect** to sign in to Geotab (MyGeotab). You will be redirected to Geotab's sign-in page — authenticate and grant access. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591): no client ID or secret is needed on your side. Accounts using SAML sign-in must first migrate to Geotab Unified Login (self-service from MyGeotab profile settings) before they can connect.

description: Connect Geotab fleet telematics via the official Geotab-hosted MCP Connector. Vehicle location, status, trips, mileage/fuel usage, faults/diagnostics, HOS/compliance, and fleet reporting. OAuth 2.1 + PKCE with Dynamic Client Registration -- no API keys required.
